output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    # identify full straight barrier of 2s
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if sum(x==2 for x in a[r])>=w-1]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if sum(a[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))>=h-1]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    if not pts:return a
    if rows:
        line=rows[0]; minr=min(r for r,c in pts); maxr=max(r for r,c in pts)
        if maxr<line: d=line-1-maxr
        else: d=line+1-minr
        dr=d if maxr<line else d
        out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if a[r][c]==2: out[r][c]=2
        for r,c in pts: out[r+dr][c]=a[r][c]
        return out
    if cols:
        line=cols[0]; minc=min(c for r,c in pts); maxc=max(c for r,c in pts)
        dc=line-1-maxc if maxc<line else line+1-minc
        out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if a[r][c]==2: out[r][c]=2
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c+dc]=a[r][c]
        return out
    return a"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    # locate color-2 barrier, assumed full row or column
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if sum(x==2 for x in a[i])>=w-1]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if sum(a[i][j]==2 for i in range(h))>=h-1]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i][j] not in (0,2)]
    if not pts:return a
    if cols:
        c=cols[0]; mn=min(j for i,j in pts); mx=max(j for i,j in pts)
        d=(c-1-mx) if mx<c else (c+1-mn)
        out=[[2 if a[i][j]==2 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        for i,j in pts: out[i][j+d]=a[i][j]
        return out
    if rows:
        r=rows[0]; mn=min(i for i,j in pts); mx=max(i for i,j in pts)
        d=(r-1-mx) if mx<r else (r+1-mn)
        out=[[2 if a[i][j]==2 else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        for i,j in pts: out[i+d][j]=a[i][j]
        return out
    return a"}
